name: Eglon
title: King of the Moabites
summary: Eglon was a Moabite king who oppressed Israel for eighteen years. The left-handed judge Ehud gained an audience with him, concealed a dagger, and killed the very fat king, freeing Israel.

keyEvents.title: Killed by Ehud
keyEvents.description: Ehud stabbed his dagger into the fat King Eglon during a secret meeting and escaped, after which Israel defeated Moab.
